protected_requirements.statement: Continue the actual Cloudflare application; establish source and deployment identity before live changes.
Preserve the existing listener history, memory, stations, preferences and account isolation.
Normal Play resumes the same durable session and ordered queue; a new queue requires a distinct explicit action.
Preserve the unfinished queue occurrence and latest observed position; if position is unavailable, replay that occurrence from its beginning.
Recognize Spotify-side Play of the same session, including after leaving the car; do not commandeer unrelated playback.
The same Spotify identity can resume on another browser/device; stale UI and stale device selection cannot replace its session.
The ordered queue can continue across rounds, app closure, pauses and restarts without losing its unfinished occurrence.
Keep discovery, old playlist resurfacing, history import, mix controls, advanced rules, favourites, bans and guest/private behavior.
Handle Spotify rate/quota limits truthfully, respect provider cooldowns on every path, and reduce measured request pressure.
Support and verify Spotify Connect through Music Assistant plus a separate capability-based route for native HA/MA players.
Build an independent calm music-player UI in German, retaining true-shuffle branding and making resume, device and queue state legible on mobile and desktop.
